reason: The company is initiating a dilutive rights issue (two shares for every one held) alongside a capital reorganization, which typically signals balance sheet stress.
why_now: The filing was released on October 7, 2026.
source_headlines: LAI GROUP (08455): (1) PROPOSED CAPITAL REORGANISATION; (2) PROPOSED CHANGE IN BOARD LOT SIZE; (3) PROPOSED INCREASE IN AUTHORISED SHARE CAPITAL; (4) PROPOSED RIGHTS ISSUE ON THE BASIS OF TWO RIGHTS SHARES FOR EVERY ONE ADJUSTED SHARE HELD ON THE RECORD DATE ON NON-FULLY UNDERWRITTEN BASIS; AND (5) CONNECTED TRANSACTION IN RELATION TO THE UNDERWRITING AGREEMENT
